commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) takes a short corner kick.

90+3' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Simon Ebonog makes way for Daren Nbenbege Mosengo (Le Havre).
89' What a save from Mory Diaw! Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
85' Abdelatif Kherradji shows a yellow card to Issa Soumare (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.
83' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) replaces Julio Enciso.
82' A pass from Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) is intercepted by Mory Diaw and the move breaks down.
80' What a chance that is! Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
79' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Arouna Sangante and he is replaced by Gautier Lloris (Le Havre).
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sofiane Boufal as he is replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
78' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
76' Martial Godo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
75' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
74' Lucas Gourna-Douath (Le Havre) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
74' Lucas Gourna-Douath (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
72' The resulting corner, taken by Julio Enciso (Strasbourg), comes to nothing.

71' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Strasbourg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
68' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
65' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
64' A substitution has been made. Fode Doucoure is replaced by Ally Samatta (Le Havre).
63' Here is a change. Enzo Koffi Vinette is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Timothee Pembele (Le Havre).
63' Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Penders, who smothers the ball.
62' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
62' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) meets a cross inside the box, but Mory Diaw wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
56' Loic Nego (Le Havre) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
54' 2 - 1 Goal! Arouna Sangante pulls the ball back for Issa Soumare (Le Havre) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
51' An attempted cross from Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) is cleared.
50' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Abdelatif Kherradji who sees an offensive foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:2.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mike Penders reads it well and gathers the ball.
45' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

44' A sweet pass finds Loic Nego (Le Havre) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Mike Penders is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Le Havre win a corner.

44' Le Havre slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
42' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) took the corner.

42' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Mike Penders makes a comfortable save. Le Havre force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
41' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
39' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) commits a rough foul. Abdelatif Kherradji stops the game and makes a call.

36' 1 - 1 Goal! Martial Godo (Strasbourg) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Mory Diaw is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
34' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
33' Substitution. Junior Mwanga is replaced by Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg).

33' So close! Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat. Good work from Le Havre as they win a corner.
32' What was Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
29' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
28' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Mory Diaw comes off his line to gather the ball.

26' 1 - 0 Stephan Zagadou (Le Havre) is in the right place at the right time to meet a well-executed corner kick and sends a close-range header towards the goal. His effort glances off the post into the top right corner and increases the score of today's match. It's now 1:0.
26' Corner kick. Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) is ready to send the ball into the box.
25' Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Le Havre get a corner.
24' Wonderful movement by Le Havre. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
23' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) is penalised for a foul. Abdelatif Kherradji had a clear view and blows his whistle.
22' Mike Penders (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
21' Mike Penders (Strasbourg) picks up an injury.
20' Dangerous play by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg). Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
17' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
17' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
15' A cross into the box from Martial Godo (Strasbourg) is cleared.
14' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
10' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

9' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the top left corner. Mike Penders is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
6' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle. Loic Nego (Le Havre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
4' That's a well-taken pass by Simon Ebonog (Le Havre). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Strasbourg will kick-off.
